picks.name: Hope
picks.why: Something unknown turns up outside a remote harbor town and the residents have to fight to survive. It's a big new creature thriller that mixes action with real horror.

picks.name: Buddy
picks.why: A girl and her friends try to escape a children's TV show that has turned sinister. It's a new horror film with a creepy, playful premise and well-reviewed scares.

picks.name: Primetime
picks.why: A dramatization of a 2006 TV host's push to make the predator-sting show a hit. It's a darkly fascinating new take on media, ego and true crime.

picks.name: Leviticus
picks.why: Two teenage boys are hunted by an entity that takes the form of the person each one desires most. It's a new horror film about longing and shame among teenagers.

picks.name: Resident Evil
picks.why: Zach Cregger's new take on the survival-horror franchise: a hapless courier is trapped in a hospital outbreak. Expect sharp, fast-moving horror with an ordinary guy in way over his head.

picks.name: Talk to Me
picks.why: Teens turn a séance hand into a party game and get hooked on possession. It's peer pressure and grief made literal, with nasty stakes that keep climbing.

picks.name: Bodies Bodies Bodies
picks.why: A group of Gen Z friends play a murder game during a hurricane party and it turns real. A wickedly funny whodunit about cruelty and paranoia inside a friend group.

picks.name: The Drama
picks.why: A happily engaged couple's wedding week goes off the rails after one revelation. It's an uncomfortable comedy about how far ordinary people will go to pretend everything is fine.

picks.name: Thoroughbreds
picks.why: Two estranged rich-kid friends in Connecticut casually talk themselves into murdering a stepfather. A deadpan, chilly dark comedy about people calmly going along with something monstrous.

picks.name: Fresh
picks.why: A dating-app meet-cute that turns into a nightmare halfway through. A darkly funny, unsettling thriller about the horror hiding behind a charming date.

series.name: The Shards
series.why: Privileged Los Angeles high schoolers in 1981 come of age while a serial killer stalks the city. It's a teen story that is also an erotic thriller and builds a slow, creeping menace.

series.name: Widow's Bay
series.why: A skeptical mayor tries to run a cursed New England island full of superstitious residents. It's a well-reviewed new horror series that is both eerie and funny.

series.name: Phony
series.why: After a car accident, a young man becomes convinced his mother has been replaced by an impostor. It's a paranoid, unsettling mystery built around a fraught mother-son relationship.

series.name: Crystal Lake
series.why: A prequel to the famous camp slasher, set in the doomed town where counselors come to die. It's a new horror series that tells its story at a slow burn.

series.name: All Her Fault
series.why: A mother's son vanishes after a playdate, and her search turns up secrets in her own circle. It's an addictive domestic thriller that is easy to binge.
